# Decision template

Copy this file to `docs/decisions/` as a numbered record. Agents write `proposed`.

## Context

Why the decision is needed, in at most two sentences.

## Decision

What was decided.

## Consequences

- What follows from it.

See the [decisions index](../decisions/README.md).
